instruction: I want to organize my reading materials better. Please extract the first three chapters from the book into separate PDF files, using the same naming format as the example chapter one file.

expected_files: 1. Symmetric matrices and adjacency of a graph.pdf

Verified by checking for presence of main book + first 3 chapter PDFs (total 4 files). Original book has 100 pages total, chapter 1 has 15 pages, chapter 2 has 11 pages, chapter 3 has 15 pages.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary score: 1.0 if all expected PDF files are present with exact names, 0.0 otherwise.
